entry.name: mc.ezadc~
entry.description: mc.ezadc~ works as a user interface version of the mc.adc~ object. It appears as a button which can be clicked with the mouse to turn audio on or off.

messages.name: (mouse)
messages.description: Clicking ontoggles audio processing on or off. Audio on is represented by the object being highlighted.

messages.name: int
messages.digest: Enable/disable audio processing in all loaded patches
messages.description: A non-zero number turns on audio processing in all loaded patches. A value ofturns all audio processing off.

messages.digest: Set the logical input channels for each signal inlet
messages.description: comprised of integers sets the logical input channels for each signal inlet.

messages.description: The word, followed by, makes a click to turn on anobject equivalent to sending it the. The messagereturns theobject to its default mode where a click to turn it on is equivalent to themessage.

messages.name: open
messages.description: Opens the Audio Status window. The window is also brought to the front.

messages.name: set
messages.digest: Set the logical input channel for a signal outlet
messages.description: The word, followed by two numbers, sets the logical input channel for one of the object's signal outlets. The first number specifies the outlet number, whereis the leftmost outlet. The second number specifies the logical input channel (from 1 to 1024). If the second number is, the outlet sends out the zero signal.

messages.name: start
messages.digest: Turns on audio processing in all loaded patches
messages.description: Turns on audio processing in all loaded patches.

messages.name: startwindow
messages.digest: Enable audio processing in local patch and subpatches only
messages.description: Turns on audio processing only in the patch in which thisis located, and in subpatches of that patch. Turns off audio processing in all other patches.

messages.digest: Turns off audio processing in all loaded patches.
messages.description: Turns off audio processing in all loaded patches.
